text: A plumbing plan covers its whole issue (#224). When the work won't fit one reviewable pull request, the planner proposes a plan of issues for it instead, in the format /invariant plan drafts, and once it's ratified by its hash the proved factory/plans runner works it, so every issue the factory opens is still one of a ratified plan's. An issue whose ratified plan of issues is under way counts as merged for the plan it belongs to only once the factory's own completion post names that plan's hash, so plans nest, and a step isn't done while any of its work is left. Before, a plan could build the first slice of an issue and name the rest, and merging it closed the issue with the rest untracked and the parent plan moving on (#212, #229, #234). @gitdek chose this on 2026-10-29 over the factory opening continued issues itself, which would open issues outside the proved core (#240).
